title: Pendulum Squat
summary: A plate-loaded squat on a swinging arc that keeps you upright and loads the quads hard at the bottom.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine); weight plates.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for quads (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.5 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.5 for adductors (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly adductors total.

setup.text: Set your shoulders under the pads with your feet in the middle of the platform.
Sit down as deep as you can, letting your knees travel forward.
Drive back up without locking out hard.

form_cues.cue: Drive up without locking the knees hard
The deep bottom is where it pays off. Use a load you can take all the way down.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, One side at a time, Lower loading potential.
